Jonathan Tremblay (born November 15, 1984) is a Canadian politician, who was elected to the House of Commons of Canada in the 2011 election . [ 2 ] He represented the electoral district of Montmorency—Charlevoix—Haute-Côte-Nord as a member of the New Democratic Party . Tremblay was defeated when he ran for re-election in 2015 . [ 3 ] Shortly after his defeat, Tremblay announced he would seek a city council seat in Beaupré in a by-election. Prior to being elected, Tremblay was a bricklayer and mason. He has three children.
